name: ordinary-cleanup
interpretation: Ordinary compaction retains the valid rule in the edited visible context.

name: helpful-history
contrast_meaning: rounding rule absent from visible shortened context
interpretation: A still-valid earlier decision is archived and omitted from the shortened visible context. Fresh abstention is information loss, not an unexplained accuracy regression.

name: obsolete-history
interpretation: The old rule is explicitly superseded; the current visible rule and permanent archive agree.
